ReviewerAblationBench
	

ReviewerAblationBench is part of AblationBench, a benchmark suite for evaluating language models on ablation planning in empirical AI research. 
It focuses on assisting reviewers by testing a model’s ability to generate missing ablation plans based on a paper’s submission.
